caption: The drawing features a rectangular area bordered by a decorative floral design on three sides: the left, top, and right edges. The background within the bordered area has a beige, textured appearance resembling woven fabric. The floral border consists of various flowers and leaves connected by winding, thin stems. The flowers are primarily in shades of pink, red, blue, and yellow, with some green leaves interspersed along the vines. The left border begins at the bottom with a blue, circular flower and continues upward with pink, orange, and red blooms and green leaves, turning right at the upper left corner into the top border. The top border includes alternating pink and blue flowers with green stems and small leaves, progressing to the upper right corner. The right border descends from the upper right, beginning with a green stem and moving down through blue, yellow, and pink flowers, ending with a single pink flower at the lower right. The beige background extends beyond the rectangular border to form a plain margin. There is no floral design along the bottom edge. Handwritten text reading "scale 1 ½" to 1 foot" appears along the bottom left margin, and "Mary Bonner" is written at the bottom right margin.
title: Bedspread
